accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with its airport category in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Orvakal, also known as Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy Airport, is a domestic greenfield no-frills airport. Bhogapuram is a greenfield international airport, while Puttaparthi has a private airstrip.
accepted.tq: Use comparison-table discrimination by matching each airport with its precise category.
accepted.sec: Airports - category

accepted.s: Which airport in Andhra Pradesh is associated with the INS Dega civil enclave?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam Airport operates from the INS Dega civil enclave. Commercial flights from this airport ended on 17 August 2026 after Bhogapuram became operational.
accepted.tq: Direct location-based recall of an airport and its civil enclave.
accepted.sec: Airports - category

accepted.s:
Consider the following airports of Andhra Pradesh:
1. Vijayawada
2. Tirupati
3. Rajahmundry
4. Kadapa
Which of the above are international airports?
accepted.x: Vijayawada and Tirupati are international airports. Rajahmundry and Kadapa are domestic airports.
accepted.tq: Split the options by separating international airports from domestic airports.
accepted.sec: Airports - category

accepted.s: The Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport is located at:
accepted.x: The Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport is the greenfield international airport at Bhogapuram in Vizianagaram district.
accepted.tq: Direct place-name recall involving a newly established infrastructure project.
accepted.sec: Airports - category

accepted.s:
With reference to the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport, consider the following statements:
1. It is being developed by GMR through a PPP-DBFOT model.
2. Its initial capacity is 6 million passengers per annum.
3. Its capacity can be expanded to 40 million passengers per annum.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The airport is being developed by GMR's GVIAL under the PPP-DBFOT model, with an initial capacity of 6 Mppa and expandable capacity of 40 Mppa.
accepted.tq: Verify all components of a project profile, including developer, model and capacity.
accepted.sec: Airports - category

accepted.s: The Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram was inaugurated by the Prime Minister on:
accepted.x: The airport was inaugurated by the Prime Minister on 1 August 2026. Commercial operations commenced later, on 17 August 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish closely spaced project milestones rather than confusing inauguration with commercial operation.
accepted.sec: Airports - category

accepted.s: The commercial operations of the Bhogapuram airport commenced on 17 August 2026 under which airport code?
accepted.x: Commercial operations at Bhogapuram commenced on 17 August 2026 under the code VTZ, with 52 flights on the first day.
accepted.tq: Numerical and code-based recall of an airport commissioning event.
accepted.sec: Airports - category

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes APADCL?
o: It is a Central Government agency for national highways.
It is the railway zone headquartered at Visakhapatnam.
It is the 100% State-owned nodal SPV for the Bhogapuram airport project.
It is a privately owned airport operator headquartered at Tirupati.
accepted.x: APADCL, formerly Bhogapuram International Airport Corporation Limited, is the 100% State-owned nodal special purpose vehicle for the Bhogapuram airport project.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct institutional responsibility instead of a neighbouring infrastructure authority.
accepted.sec: Airports - category

accepted.s: Before August 2026, how many airports were listed as operating in Andhra Pradesh in the stated international-domestic classification?
accepted.x: Before August 2026, Andhra Pradesh had six listed airports: three international—Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Tirupati—and three domestic—Rajahmundry, Kadapa and Orvakal.
accepted.tq: Count the entries after grouping them by category.
accepted.sec: Airports - category

accepted.s: Which airport was described as the first South Indian airport built entirely by a State Government?
accepted.x: Orvakal, or Uyyalawada Narasimha Reddy Airport in Kurnool, was described as the first South Indian airport built entirely by a State Government.
accepted.tq: Direct distinction based on the unique project description.
accepted.sec: Airports - category

accepted.s: Orvakal Airport began flight operations in:
accepted.x: Flights from Orvakal Airport began on 28 March 2021; the airport has been operational since March 2021.
accepted.tq: Use the exact operational date rather than the date of a later airport project.
accepted.sec: Airports - category

accepted.s: Tirupati airport acquired international status in:
accepted.x: Tirupati airport has had international status since October 2015.
accepted.tq: Direct date recall for a status change.
accepted.sec: Airports - category

accepted.s: The runway of Rajahmundry Airport was extended to:
accepted.x: The Rajahmundry airport runway was extended to 3,165 metres. A new terminal costing ₹350 crore was also associated with the airport's development.
accepted.tq: Separate airport-specific measurements from nearby infrastructure figures.
accepted.sec: Airports - category

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT included among the proposed greenfield airport locations in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Dagadarthi, Kuppam and Srikakulam are among the proposed greenfield airport locations. Gannavaram is the existing location of Vijayawada Airport.
accepted.tq: Find the location that does not belong to the proposed greenfield-airport list.
accepted.sec: Airports - category

accepted.s: The total length of National Highways in Andhra Pradesh was stated as approximately:
accepted.x: The National Highway network in Andhra Pradesh was stated to be 8,744 km. The total road length was 54,177 km.

accepted.s: Which statement correctly compares the National Highway density of Andhra Pradesh with the all-India figure?
o: 54.177 km per lakh population in Andhra Pradesh against 8.744 km all-India
8.744 km per lakh population in Andhra Pradesh against 54.177 km all-India
12.09 km per lakh population in Andhra Pradesh against 17.64 km all-India
17.64 km per lakh population in Andhra Pradesh against 12.09 km all-India

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding National Highway projects in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Ninety-three projects were under way.
2. Their combined length was 2,065 km.
3. Their stated cost was ₹45,633 crore.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three figures are correct: 93 projects, covering 2,065 km, with a stated cost of ₹45,633 crore.
accepted.tq: Check a project statistic as a complete numerical package.
accepted.sec: National highways and expressways - length, Bharatmala, Sagarmala

accepted.s: How many kilometres of National Highway work were stated to have been completed in Andhra Pradesh during 2025–26?
accepted.x: A total of 392 km of National Highway work was stated to have been completed during 2025–26.
accepted.tq: Distinguish completed length from the total length of projects under way.
accepted.sec: National highways and expressways - length, Bharatmala, Sagarmala

accepted.s: The National Highway works targeted for completion by 2029 were valued at over:
accepted.x: National Highway works worth more than ₹1.40 lakh crore were targeted for completion by 2029.
accepted.tq: Match the financial value with the correct infrastructure programme and deadline.
accepted.sec: National highways and expressways - length, Bharatmala, Sagarmala

accepted.s: Which project was stated to be due for completion by 2027?
accepted.x: The Bengaluru–Kadapa–Vijayawada Economic Corridor was stated to be due by 2027. A DPR was ordered separately for the Kharagpur–Amaravati expressway.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between projects by their stated implementation stage and deadline.
accepted.sec: National highways and expressways - length, Bharatmala, Sagarmala

accepted.s: The Raipur–Visakhapatnam greenfield expressway is associated with which programme?
accepted.x: The Raipur–Visakhapatnam greenfield expressway is described as a Bharatmala economic corridor.

Match List-I with List-II:

accepted.s: South Coast Railway is:
o: India's 16th railway zone headquartered at Vijayawada
India's 18th railway zone headquartered at Visakhapatnam
India's 17th railway zone headquartered at Guntur
India's 19th railway zone headquartered at Guntakal
accepted.x: South Coast Railway is India's 18th railway zone, with its headquarters at Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of the zone number and headquarters, a common paired trap.
accepted.sec: Railways in AP - new zone, new lines, freight corridors

accepted.s: Which set correctly represents the divisions of South Coast Railway?
accepted.x: The divisions of South Coast Railway are Guntakal, Guntur, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Recall a complete administrative composition list without substituting nearby regional places.
accepted.sec: Railways in AP - new zone, new lines, freight corridors

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about South Coast Railway:
1. Its creation was promised in the A.P. Reorganisation Act, 2014.
2. The promise appears in the Thirteenth Schedule of the Act.
3. It was carved out of the South Central Railway and East Coast Railway.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. South Coast Railway was promised in the Thirteenth Schedule of the A.P. Reorganisation Act, 2014, and was carved from SCR and ECoR.
accepted.tq: Combine a legal provision with the organisational origin of a new body.
accepted.sec: Railways in AP - new zone, new lines, freight corridors

accepted.s: The proposed Amaravati railway line is the:
o: 57-km Errupalem–Nambur line including a 3-km Krishna bridge
92-km Errupalem–Nambur line including a 3-km Krishna bridge
3-km Errupalem–Nambur line including a 57-km Krishna bridge
57-km Guntakal–Guntur line including a 5-km Godavari bridge
accepted.x: The Amaravati line is a 57-km Errupalem–Nambur railway line, including a 3-km bridge over the Krishna River.
accepted.tq: Keep the route length and bridge length in their correct positions.
accepted.sec: Railways in AP - new zone, new lines, freight corridors

accepted.s: Which statement about the railway network of Andhra Pradesh is correct?
o: It is 75% electrified and has ₹45,633 crore of works under way.
It is 100% electrified and has ₹18,000 crore of rail works under way.
It is 50% electrified and has ₹92,649 crore of rail works completed.
It is 100% electrified and has ₹92,649 crore of rail works under way.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh's railway network was stated to be 100% electrified, with ₹92,649 crore of railway works under way.
accepted.tq: Check both the percentage and the associated financial figure before selecting an option.
accepted.sec: Railways in AP - new zone, new lines, freight corridors

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about APIIC:
1. It is wholly State-owned.
2. It is associated with industrial parks, estates, SEZs, EMCs and a land bank.
3. It performs industrial financing and promotion as its principal role instead of APIDC.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Industrial financing and promotion are associated with APIDC, whereas APIIC focuses on industrial infrastructure and land development.
accepted.tq: Separate the roles of two similarly named industrial corporations.
accepted.sec: APIIC and APIDC - incorporation, parks, land bank

accepted.s: According to the stated 2025–26 figures, APIIC had how many parks and estates respectively?
accepted.x: APIIC was stated to have 331 parks and 304 estates in 2025–26.
accepted.tq: Preserve the order of paired statistics instead of reversing the two categories.
accepted.sec: APIIC and APIDC - incorporation, parks, land bank

accepted.s: The 331 parks and 304 estates of APIIC were stated to constitute how many clusters?
accepted.x: The figures were presented as 331 UDLs and 635 clusters, with the 331 parks and 304 estates forming the stated industrial infrastructure network.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a component count from the aggregate cluster count.
accepted.sec: APIIC and APIDC - incorporation, parks, land bank

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched with the stated APIIC figure for 2025–26?
accepted.x: APIIC had developed approximately 1.21 lakh acres. Its land bank was 41,998 acres and it had 25 joint ventures.
